lessons.title: The game loop: input, update, render
lessons.summary: The three jobs every engine repeats each frame, the order they run in, who owns each piece of data, and where Godot and Unity call your code.

lessons.title: Update versus render: two clocks in one loop
lessons.summary: Why simulation and drawing run on separate clocks, what repeated frames, unseen updates and judder are, and how Godot and Unity set each rate.
